purpose: Candidate inventory for building the new ANHC corpus. Metadata discovery is not a download, rights clearance, annotation, or training admission.

sources.title: DarijaStory
sources.material: 4,392 long stories or story chapters; a single train split
sources.provenance: Dataset card reports web scraping from 9esa.com
blockers: Confirm 9esa source terms and underlying author rights independently of the dataset-card license.
Inspect records, remove duplicates, and group chapters by parent story before assigning splits.

sources.title: Darija (Moroccan Arabic) Stories Dataset
sources.material: 6,142 chapter rows; dataset card claims over 70 million tokens
sources.provenance: Chapter text has author, URL, and tags fields per dataset card; exact upstream rights are not established here.
blockers: Verify the license applies to each underlying work and not only the compilation.
Non-commercial restriction must be carried into all training and release decisions.
Recount tokens using the project tokenizer; do not use the reported 70M as ANHC count.

sources.title: Layla Witheeb: Jordanian Arabic Acoustic Dataset
sources.material: Audio, orthographic and phonetic transcripts, and metadata for 109 speakers reading and telling a short story
sources.provenance: Dataset paper reports native Jordanian university speakers and a reading plus storytelling task based on an adapted Little Red Riding Hood story.
blockers: Read the Mendeley record and verify dataset-specific license before transcript ingestion.
All recordings retell/read the same short story, so this is not a diverse plot corpus.
Treat transcripts as retellings, not independent authored stories.

sources.title: Curras / Currasat Palestinian Arabic corpus
sources.material: About 56K tokens in the earlier Curras description; corpus includes a limited story subset collected from different sources/forums, including a Cinderella story.
sources.provenance: Birzeit corpus and paper; narrative items are a subset of a broader morphologically annotated dialect corpus.
sources.declared_license: CC-BY-4.0 listed on the corpus download page (verify the exact release and included story sources).
blockers: Separate story records from lexicon, social media, and other corpus material.
Verify license/version and source-level rights for each story.

sources.title: TinyStories Algerian Darija
sources.material: 11,326 parallel English–Darija child-story pairs; one train split
sources.provenance: Dataset card states machine-generated translation and cultural adaptation from TinyStories; underlying TinyStories is declared CDLA-Sharing-1.0.
sources.declared_license: MIT claimed for derivative dataset; source license is CDLA-Sharing-1.0.
blockers: Keep synthetic/adapted stories distinct from authentic folk or human-authored narratives.
Review source and derivative license obligations before use.
Group each English/Darija pair and source story in one split.

sources.title: Algerian Darja Corpus
sources.material: 11,151 long-form conversational transcript rows; paper-reported 34,336,366 words
sources.provenance: Dataset card reports YouTube podcast transcripts plus three audio collections; row-level source identifiers and licenses are absent.
blockers: Not a story dataset: conversational transcripts must not count as ANHC narrative tokens.
The card reports missing row-level source IDs/licenses; resolve provenance before importing.
Do not reuse the single train split as a test partition.

sources.title: Sanaa AI dialect stories
sources.material: Short modern dialect stories and proverb explanations
sources.provenance: Site-provided labels; authorship and generation process not established
blockers: Do not scrape or ingest story text until authorship and reuse permissions are established.
Site dialect labels are not gold annotations.

sources.title: Arabic Stories Corpus
sources.provenance: Reported source websites need record-level review.
blockers: Repository license alone does not establish that the underlying story texts may be redistributed or used for training.

sources.title: AraStories
sources.provenance: Repository/paper describe generated and translated material.
blockers: Separate model-generated, translated, and other records; MIT code/repository license does not by itself resolve rights in all content.

not_story_corpora.reason: Tweets and task-specific dialect annotations, not long-form narratives.
Verb lexicon and syntactic/semantic frames, not a story corpus; license still needs verification.
Mixed sentence-level classification data; not narrative text and constituent licenses vary.
NER annotations and models are useful for character/entity consistency, not for story generation training; full corpus access and model terms require review.

intake_order: inspect dataset metadata, rows, duplicates, document and chapter relationships without copying copyrighted text into ANSG
verify dataset and underlying-source rights and pin dataset revision
run row-level genre, dialect, script, and quality profiling
create a separate quarantine staging file for approved text only
group parallel, nested, retold, and duplicate story families before a frozen split
annotate DIA, MOTIF, and MORAL with automatic, silver, and human-adjudicated gold kept distinct
